what_this_is: The models and representations the DEEP RUN and CENSORING run on, on both pipelines. Read by every deep-run task WHEN IT STARTS, not when it was generated -- so this file can be edited at any time up to the moment a task begins, and that is the point of it.
the_rule: RERUN_PLAN.md 13.17 B. Seeded 2026-09-05 with the six models the author settled on 2026-09-04, before the screen finished. SETTLED 2026-09-07: the author's call was to keep het_gp_rbf AND add dnn_vbll_hetero, so this is seven models. Re-read it with: python scripts/select_deep_run_pairs.py --results-dir results
one_way: NARROWING this list later is free -- a task that is no longer listed skips and exits 0. WIDENING it means resubmitting the indices of the models you add, because a task that already skipped stays skipped.

why_each.ngboost: locked on by 13.17 B; the generator refuses to build a deep run without it
why_each.rf: most noise-tolerant model on all three representations in the screen
why_each.het_gp_rbf: least noise-tolerant on two of three when this file was seeded. The corrected reading at six models put dnn_vbll_hetero below it on all nine combinations of three representations and three noise types; the author kept BOTH 2026-09-07 rather than choose
why_each.svm: the only kernel model; covers a family nothing else does
why_each.gauche_rbf: author's addition, for the per-molecule uncertainty requirement: aleatoric x17.2 against epistemic x1.5, the cleanest separation in the roster (5.5i). KEPT 2026-09-07: the reading picks `gauche` for the Gaussian-process slot on its position in MODEL_ORDER, not on a score, and `gauche` is the Tanimoto kernel, defined on binary fingerprints alone -- taking it would leave the deep run with no Gaussian process on PDV or ChemBERTa
why_each.dnn_bnn_full_mve: author's addition: x2.5 against x1.1, and the literature's flagship variance-head case. KEPT 2026-09-07: the reading picks `dnn` for the plain-neural slot on MODEL_ORDER position, and dropping this model would leave censoring with one model emitting a per-molecule uncertainty where noise_conditions.json requires two
why_each.dnn_vbll_hetero: author, 2026-09-07: added alongside het_gp_rbf. It is what the corrected reading picks for the least noise-tolerant slot -- lower auc_norm than het_gp_rbf on all nine combinations of three representations and three noise types, e.g. ECFP4 under gaussian 0.8838 against 0.9238 (RERUN_PLAN.md 13.27 D4a). Its 18 tasks had already skipped, so they need resubmitting: bash resubmit_selected.sh dnn_bnn_full_variational_hetero

settled: 2026-09-07 by the author, on the corrected reading at six models over 20,224 result rows. Three slots were in question; one was decided by keeping both candidates and the other two by the reading having picked its candidates off MODEL_ORDER rather than off a number. RERUN_PLAN.md 13.27 D4.
